guides.title: Add a new Package (sponsorship / exhibitor package)
questions: How do I add a new package?
How do I add a package?
create sponsorship package
add product to shop
shop products where is it
where are products

steps.text: Open Shop › Products from the left menu.
steps.label: Products

steps.text: In the **Packages** section click **Add New**.
steps.label: Add New

steps.text: Fill **Name**, **List Price**, keep **Stock Status = In Stock** and enter **Stock Quantity**.
steps.label: Name

steps.text: Pick **Assign Level** (the level the buyer gets, e.g. Exhibitor). You can type a new level name there to create it.
steps.label: Assign Level

steps.text: Optional: upload an Image (1024×1024), write Product Description and Line Item Description (shows on invoice).
steps.label: Product Description

steps.text: Optional: **Advanced** ▸ Group, Maximum Quantity Per Company, Tags. **Workflows** ▸ Include These Booths In Item Price, Assign Tasks, Assign Priority Points.
steps.label: Workflows

steps.text: Click **Save** → “Item created successfully”.
steps.label: Save

guides.notes: Keep 'Item is visible' ON or exhibitors will not see it. Packages are tiers; Add-Ons are optional extras.

guides.title: Create an order / invoice for a company (admin)
questions: How do I create an invoice for an exhibitor?
How do I create an order from the admin side?

steps.text: Open Shop › Orders.
steps.label: Orders

steps.text: Click **Create Order**.
steps.label: Create Order

steps.text: Pick the **Company** and **Type** (Invoice = amount due, Sales Receipt = paid) → **Continue**.
steps.label: Continue

steps.text: Go through the steps: Select Package → Select Booth → Add-Ons (click **Add to Cart**, then **Next**).
steps.label: Add to Cart

steps.text: In **Review Cart** you can change Qty and **Sale Price**, apply a Discount Code, add Notes (shown on invoice) and Hidden Notes.

guides.title: Create a discount / coupon code
questions: How do I create a discount code?
How do I create a discount code?
10% coupon

steps.text: Open Shop › Advanced (tab **Payment Rules**).
steps.label: Payment Rules

steps.text: Click the **Discount Codes** card.
steps.label: Discount Codes

steps.text: Enter **Rule Name** (internal) and **User-Facing Name** (shows in cart) — the user-facing name auto-copies the rule name, so fix it if needed.
steps.label: RULE NAME

steps.text: In **IF Discount Code equals** clear the auto-filled text and type your code (case-insensitive).
steps.label: Discount Code

steps.text: THEN **Apply Discount** → Take X **Percentage**/amount off → Applies to Entire Cart / Product Category / Specific Product(s).
steps.label: Apply Discount

steps.text: Optional CODE DETAILS: Total Uses, Uses Per Company, Expiration Date.
steps.label: Total Uses

steps.text: Click **Save Rule** → “Rule created successfully”.
steps.label: Save Rule

guides.notes: Exhibitors enter the code in Review Cart → Apply Discount. Turn a rule on/off with the toggle in 'Your active rules'. Hide the code box via Event Setup › Advanced Settings › Hide Discount Code Field.

guides.title: Enable booth staff registration (Booth Staff Settings)
questions: How do I enable booth staff registration?
How do I let exhibitors add their own booth staff?

steps.text: Open Companies › More › **Booth Staff**.
steps.label: Booth Staff

steps.text: Click **Booth Staff Settings**.
steps.label: Booth Staff Settings

steps.text: Enable: **Allow Public Registration Form**, **Allow Exhibitor to Add Booth Staff**, **Allow Exhibitor to Edit & Delete Booth Staff**. Optionally hide the count → **Save**.
steps.label: Save

guides.notes: If exhibitors still can't add staff after enabling, check their booth staff limit (limit = 0 means they see '0 of 0').

guides.title: Increase booth staff limit for a level or company
questions: How do I increase the booth staff limit?
Exhibitor sees 'Registered Staff 0 of 0'
How do I give a company more booth staff slots?
Booth staff limit is 0
How do I set booth staff limit per level?

steps.text: **For all companies in a level:** Open Companies › **Levels** → ✎ edit the level → set **Booth Staff Limit** → Save.
steps.label: Levels

steps.text: **For one specific company:** Companies › Companies → ✎ edit the company → **Company Settings** → **Booth Staff Settings** → set Override limit → **Save Settings**.
steps.label: Company Settings

steps.text: **Via add-on:** Edit the add-on product → **Workflows** → **Increase Booth Staff Registration Limit** → set the number → Save.
steps.label: Workflows

guides.notes: If the exhibitor sees 'Registered Staff 0 of 0', their limit is 0 — raise it at the level or override per company.

guides.title: Put a booth up for sale / set booth price (Self-booth Purchase popup)
questions: How do I set a booth price?
How do I put a booth up for sale?
exhibitor can't buy booth
How do I let only one level buy a booth?
Can a booth purchase give the exhibitor a level?
How do I change a booth price?

steps.text: Open **Floor Plan** and click **Edit ✎** on the floor plan card.
steps.label: Edit

steps.text: Click the booth on the canvas (shift-click or drag to select several — the popup changes ALL selected booths).
In the right panel under **Self-Booth Purchase** click **Sell Booth** (or **Edit** if it is already for sale).
steps.label: Sell Booth

steps.text: In the **Self-booth Purchase** popup check **Selected Booths**, then enter the **Price** ($).
steps.label: Price

steps.text: **Level Purchasability**: which levels may buy it (All, or e.g. Exhibitor). **User Purchasability**: optionally limit to specific users.
steps.label: Level Purchasability

steps.text: Optional **Product Description** — shows in the booth pop-up for buyers (hidden after the booth is purchased).
steps.label: Product Description

steps.text: Optional **Level Based Discount**: pick Levels, Discount Type (Fixed / Percent) and the Discount.
steps.label: Level Based Discount

steps.text: Optional **IF this booth is purchased, THEN**: Override User's Existing Level + **Assign User Level**, **Increase Booth Staff Limit**, **Priority Points**.
steps.label: Assign User Level

steps.text: Click **Update** → “Booth detail has been successfully updated”.
steps.label: Update

steps.text: Click **Save** at the top of the editor and wait for “Floorplan has been saved successfully”, then **Exit** the editor.
steps.label: Save

guides.notes: Warning shown in the popup: changes apply to every booth in the current selection and override previous Price, Description and Level. Without Sell Booth the exhibitor only sees the booth number (no Reserve Booth). 'Don't Sell Booth' takes it off sale. Hidden in this event: Enable Deposits (Deposit OR Pay in Full / Deposit Only / No) with Deposits Type (Percentage / Fixed Amount) and Deposit Amount, and Option to Reserve?

How do I create a new portal?
How do I clone an event?

steps.text: In the top-right corner open the **Events** drop-down (next to the organization drop-down).
At the bottom of the list click **Create New Event** and complete the Event Setup Form (Event Details → Add Team → Registration Flow → Notifications → Insurance → Advanced Settings → Publish).

steps.text: For each area choose **Clone** or **Skip**: Settings, Invoice Templates, Email Templates, Menu and Pages, Levels, Tasks, Resources, Shop, Reports, Companies/Users (Add), Company/User/Contact/Billing Fields, Floor Plan.
Tick the acknowledgement and click **Clone**.

guides.notes: Taught by ExpoGenie Support. Cloning copies INTO the event that is currently selected and cannot be undone — it can overwrite what is already in that portal. Companies and Users clone only basic info (first/last name, company, level, email).
guides.reply:
Thank you for reaching out!

steps.text: In the left sidebar, go to **Companies** → **Applications** (or the Pending section).
steps.label: Applications

steps.label: Approve

steps.text: To let the exhibitor choose their own package, assign the **Unassigned** level — they will pick a package through the Shop Wizard.

guides.notes: Use 'Unassigned' if the exhibitor will purchase their own package. Assign a specific level if you want to set it for them directly.

steps.text: First, add the company to the new event: **Companies** → **Add** → **Add New Company**.

steps.text: Fill in the company details and save.
steps.label: Save

steps.text: Open the new company, go to the **Users** tab, and click **Add User**.
steps.label: Add User

steps.text: Enter the user's email — if they already exist in ERC, their account will be linked automatically.

steps.text: Send them a welcome email or let them log in — their existing password will work.

contact fields where is itn

steps.text: Open **Forms** in the left sidebar.

steps.text: Click **More** to expand the sub-menu, then click **Contact Fields**.
steps.label: Contact Fields

steps.text: Click **Add New**.
steps.label: Add New
